text:
rita: FYI onboarding/sample-app users are hammering the "redo last prompt" button and we're seeing duplicate downstream jobs + a spike of 429s. Repro is easy: click replay 3x quickly.

omar: Which client? node/go/ruby? streaming?

lita: Mostly Node web client v1.5.0, sync generation. A few Ruby samples too. No streaming.

omar: Classic missing-idempotency + aggressive retry combo. Do we set any idempotency header by default?

lita: Node doesn't. Ruby has a helper in examples but it's opt-in. No parity.

mike: Short-term: add a UI debounce (300-700ms) and store requestFingerprint in sessionStorage to avoid identical replays for TTL (3m). Also server-side webhook receiver should dedupe by fingerprint header.

rita: Also noticed some 429s lacking Retry-After header. Snippet: 
```
POST /v1/generate 429
x-request-id: r-zz9
body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```
No Retry-After makes exponential backoff implementations restart too fast.

infra-bot: Note created: TICK-492 audit smart-routing for missing Retry-After headers.

omar: For SDK parity plan: (1) add `idempotencyKey()` helper to Node & Ruby; (2) change default retry to exp backoff with full jitter; (3) make idempotency opt-out for streaming APIs. Proposed backoff params: base=100ms, factor=2, max=2500ms, jitter=uniform(0..delay).

lita: Could we show a tiny snippet in onboarding docs for generating a fingerprint: 
```
const fingerprint = sha256(userId + '|' + promptText).slice(0,16)
X-Redwood-Idempotency: fingerprint
```
Works across SDKs and keeps headers short.

mike: Agree. Also recommend server keep idempotency cache for 5 minutes. That covers quick accidental replays.

rita: Omar, can you take the Node PR for idempotency helper + default backoff? Include tests that streaming requests don't set the header.

omar: I'll open the PR today. Will add integration test that simulates 30 concurrent identical requests and asserts single webhook delivery.

lita: I'll update onboarding sample-app (debounce + fingerprint store) and add a short explainer in the README.

mike: Ops will prioritize TICK-492. If smart-routing is striping Retry-After on fallback, that's risky.

infra-bot: patch deployed to staging: sdk/node/default-backoff -> staging (CI ok)

rita: Thanks. Aim to have sampleapp + node patch in staging by EOD Wednesday so docs can ship before next onboarding wave. Ping here for reviews. :rocket:
